title: Evaluation of the Universal Circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables, and let $x$ be such an assignment. The universal circuit representing $f$, evaluated at $x$, has value $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps assignments of $n$ Boolean variables to a Boolean value
$x$ is an assignment of $n$ Boolean variables
